How much is a used Nintendo Switch OLED worth?

The Switch OLED is one of the most traded consoles on eBay and Vinted. Since the Switch 2 came out in 2025 many more are for sale, so old price guides are out of date: compare current listings only.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The OLED model has a 7-inch screen, a wide adjustable stand along the whole back and a dock with a LAN port. The model number on the back is HEG-001. The original Switch (HAC-001) and the Switch Lite (HDH-001) are different products with lower prices, so make sure listings you compare with are the OLED.

What decides the price

  • Edition: special editions (for example Zelda or Pokémon designs) usually sell above the white and neon versions, but only when the matching dock and Joy-Con are included.
  • Joy-Con: stick drift is the most common fault and lowers the price. Original Joy-Con sell better than third-party ones.
  • Screen: scratches on the OLED screen are hard to hide in photos and cost more than scratches on the back.
  • Completeness: dock, power supply, HDMI cable, Joy-Con grip and straps, and the original box.
  • Bundles: games and cases add less than their shop price. Compare a console alone with consoles alone.

Check before you buy

  • Joy-Con: move both sticks slowly in a circle in System Settings, Controllers and Sensors, Calibrate Control Sticks.
  • Screen: look for scratches, dead pixels and lines on a white and a dark background.
  • Dock: test TV output, the console should charge in the dock.
  • Account: the seller should have removed their Nintendo Account and reset the console.
  • Ask whether the console has been banned from online play.

Where it sells best

Sells well on eBay and Vinted, and locally where buyers can test it. Ship in the original box or a padded box: the console and dock are fragile and heavy enough that shipping cost matters for your profit.

Today's price

Prices for a used Nintendo Switch OLED change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Nintendo Switch OLED worth?

It depends on edition, Joy-Con condition, screen and completeness. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Nintendo Switch OLED" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Did the Switch 2 make the Switch OLED worth less?

More used Switch OLED consoles came on the market after the Switch 2 launch in 2025, which pushed prices down. The OLED still sells steadily because it is cheaper and plays the same Switch games, so check the current price, not last year's.

Is a Switch OLED without the box worth much less?

Usually somewhat less, and it is harder to ship safely. The power supply and dock matter more than the box: a console without its dock is clearly worth less.
